text:
An audit of Brisco County's finances has found $2.3 million in road maintenance funds that cannot be accounted for.

The findings were made public on March 14, 2024, when County Auditor Dolores Venkataraman presented the Brisco County Fiscal Year 2022-23 Performance Audit to the county board during its regular public session.

According to the report, the missing money was earmarked for road maintenance but could not be traced through county records to completed work or other documented spending.

"Our review could not account for these funds, and that is a serious concern for taxpayers," Venkataraman told the board.

The audit covers the county's 2022-23 fiscal year. Board members received the document at the session, where it was released to the public.

The Harbour Dispatch will report further as the county responds to the audit's findings.
